programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo, que viaja en un convoy, duplica esfuerzos en su misión de ayudar a los sobrevivientes. Empeñados en alentar a más sobrevivientes a que se acerquen, Al, Luciana y Charlie envían a Morgan y al grupo a una peligrosa misión.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Morgan y Grace buscan provisiones en un centro comercial abandonado para, además, cumplir el último deseo de un hombre moribundo. Sin embargo, la misión termina convirtiéndose en una lucha por la supervivencia.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras busca un hogar permanente para el grupo, Charlie llega a una sinagoga donde se encuentra con un rabino que sobrevive por su cuenta. Sarah y Dwight se enfrentan a enemigos inesperados.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Se revelan los motivos de Logan. Sarah, Dwight y Luciana negocian por el bien de la misión. Strand y Alicia ayudan a un nuevo sobreviviente en un lugar conocido. Surge una peligrosa amenaza.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Un encuentro con un sobreviviente envía a Al y Morgan a una misión en un asentamiento peligroso. Al sigue una pista mientras Morgan tiene una epifanía. Grace y Daniel tienen una conexión.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Cuando Virginia hace una declaración, Al responde de la misma forma. June enfrenta circunstancias terribles, pese a ello, busca un nuevo lugar para llamarlo hogar. El estado de salud de Grace empeora y Morgan toma una decisión difícil.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire

programme.desc: En 1910, en Nueva Orleans, la vida de Louis de Pointe du Lac, hasta entonces administrador de la fortuna de su familia, cambia por completo al conocer al vampiro Lestat. En 2020, Louis le narra la historia de su vida a un periodista.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.sub-title: Tras los fantasmas de quien solías ser
programme.desc: Louis empieza a aprender la realidad del vampirismo de la mano de su maestro y compañero, Lestat, pero, poco a poco, se da cuenta de que entre ellos dos hay diferencias. En el presente, en Dubái, Louis le revela nuevos secretos a Molloy.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire
programme.sub-title: Mi propia naturaleza es la de un demonio
programme.desc: La llegada de un viejo amigo pone en peligro la relación de Louis y Lestat. La vida como vampiro de Louis se ve afectada por el creciente malestar social que se respira en Nueva Orleans, el cual repercute en sus negocios.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire

programme.desc: La transformación de Claudia en vampiro cambia las vidas de Louis y Lestat. A medida que Claudia hace más preguntas, Louis y Lestat se ven obligados a enfrentarse a sus dudas. Claudia descubre las realidades de su nueva vida.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire

programme.desc: Claudia se va de la casa para formarse académicamente e investigar acerca del vampirismo. En la época de la Gran Depresión, la hermana de Louis se pone en contacto con él y la tensión estalla con el regreso de Claudia.

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire

programme.title: Interview With the Vampire

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat meets the trio behind Blood Bros BBQ to discover how three childhood friends seamlessly blended their Asian-American culture with the Texas barbecue traditions they grew up with.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Gaby Molinar owns Huerto Urbano, an urban farm dedicated to providing Monterrey with nutritious, diverse local ingredients. And her husband is one of the region's greatest culinary pioneers.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los ⚽ [Liga MX] Tigres and Los ⚽ [Liga MX] Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Two sisters made a little shack on the Rio Ramos into a must-visit restaurant known for one dish: cortadillo stew. Down the road, another restaurant uses traditional stews in their famous empalmes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
programme.sub-title: Grilled Steak Salad and Italian-style Lamb Chops
programme.desc: Jamie shares his perfect Steak & Chargrilled Salad, a Chicken Caesar Salad with an upgrade on the bars, Italia-inspired Sizzling Lamb Lollipops and his delicious Whole Barbecue Fish & Ratatouille to upgrade your grill skills!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
programme.sub-title: Grilled Fish Tacos and a Veggie Pancake
programme.desc: For the ultimate BBQ experience, Jamie cooks a Butterflied Leg of Lamb, his Spiced Chicken Kebabs and creamy butter sauce perfect for a party, followed by Grilled Fish Tacos and Jamie's Tear 'n' Share Veggie Pancake ready to feed a crowd.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
programme.sub-title: Sesame Chicken Burger and Surf & Turf Mixed Grill
programme.desc: Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread; and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser!

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread!

programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero
programme.desc: Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero!

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.sub-title: Pit-Cooked Chicken with Alabama White Sauce
programme.desc: Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.sub-title: Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville
programme.desc: Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.desc: Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.sub-title: Bluefin Tuna Collars with Chili Pickle Relish
programme.desc: Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars.

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
programme.sub-title: The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs
programme.desc: Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.sub-title: Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
programme.desc: Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.sub-title: Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
programme.desc: Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.title: Divorce Court
programme.sub-title: Winter Storm: Winter Bush vs. Calvin Ross

programme.title: Divorce Court

programme.title: Divorce Court
programme.sub-title: Endless Cycle of Heartbreak: "Esmy" Valdez vs. Jordan Sherman
programme.desc: Esmy says her fiancé is very controlling, prevented her from going on her friend's podcast and tracks her every move; Jordan says he is not controlling, he's "protective."

programme.title: Divorce Court
programme.sub-title: Lazy Wife, Crazy Life: Andrea Murrell-Thomas vs. Taja Thomas
programme.desc: Andrea says that for the first two years of their relationship, she carried all the financial burden, because Taya didn't have a job, and for two months they had to [LIVE] in a van; Taya says she contributes in other ways to their marriage.

programme.title: Divorce Court
programme.sub-title: Downward Spiral: Shunica Ingram vs. James Ingram

programme.title: Divorce Court

programme.title: Divorce Court

programme.title: Divorce Court

programme.title: Divorce Court

programme.title: Daria

programme.title: Tombstone Territory

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: With his fiancée arriving from London, Ron Browning will do anything to keep her from finding out what a failure he is…even die…at least on paper. But his courage in a later crisis may restore his self-respect and save the Sheriff at the same time.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1996, una agencia federal dictaminó que Terri Strickland había provocado intencionalmente el fuego que mató a su hijo de 17 meses, Josh Hinson.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En la búsqueda del asesino de dos adolescentes de Texas, un perfil de conducta llevó a sospechar de Jason Massey. La ciencia demostró que el perfil era correcto y Massey fue ejecutado mediante inyección letal el 3 de Abril del 2001.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Impresiones fuertes

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Es musgo, no grama

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 2008, la respuesta de emergencia de Illinois atendió un incendio en un garaje y se encontró a un hombre aplastado debajo de un camión.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un asesino en serie andaba suelto y la policía tenía que encontrarlo antes de que atacara nuevamente. Su pista más prometedora era inusual: una huella dactilar sangrienta en el cuerpo de una de las víctimas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Mientras estaba practicando tiros en un hermoso día de primavera, Martin Dillon es asesinado con disparos. Su amigo sostiene que fue un extraño accidente, pero se necesitan más de 20 años para que la verdad salga a la luz.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Una joven mujer asiste a los servicios religiosos de la tarde y luego desaparece. Cuando se encuentra su automóvil abandonado, el tanque está vacío y falta una lata de gasolina que tenía en su baúl para emergencias.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1987, se descubrieron un cráneo humano y algunos huesos en un campamento de niños exploradores cerca de Farmington, Missouri. La reconstrucción facial ayuda a los investigadores en este caso.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Manny Pacquiao vs Miguel Cotto
programme.desc: On November 14th, 2009, Manny Pacquiao fought Miguel Cotto for the WBO and WBC Diamond Welterweight Titles at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Pacquiao put on a dominant performance, forcing the ref to stop the fight in round 12.

programme.title: Manny Pacquiao vs Oscar De La Hoya

programme.title: Manny Pacquiao vs Timothy Bradley III
programme.desc: On April 9th, 2016 Manny Pacquiao faced Timothy Bradley for the third time at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas for the WBO International Welterweight title in a 12 round bout Bradley went down in round 7 and 9 resulting in a success for Pacquiao.

programme.title: Marvin Hagler vs John Mugabi
programme.desc: On March 10th, 1986 Marvin Hagler and John Mugabi fought at the Caesars Palace Outdoor Arena in Las Vegas for IBF, WBA and WBC world middleweight titles while Mugabi was ranked number 1 by all three bodies the fight ended in a victory for Hagler.

programme.title: Marvin Hagler vs Thomas Hearns
programme.desc: On April 15th, 1985, Marvin Hagler fought Thomas Hearns for the undisputed Middleweight Title at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas. Hagler and Hearns absolutely went at it from the bell which ended with Hagler securing a thrilling knockout victory.

programme.title: Matthew Saad Muhammad vs Yaqui Lopez 1
programme.desc: On October 24th, 1978 Matthew Saad Muhammad fought Yaqui Lopez for the first time for Light Heavyweight titles at the Spectrum in Philidelphia, in a 15 round bout that ended in the fourteenth round securing the victory for Muhammad.

programme.title: Michael Carabajal vs Jorge Arce
programme.desc: On July 31st, 1999 Michael Carabajal faced Jorge Arce for the WBO World Light flyweight title at Plaza de Toros El Toreo in Tijuana in a 12 round bout that went 11 rounds giving the bout to Carabajal.

programme.title: Michael Carbajal vs Humberto Gonzalez 1
programme.desc: On March 13th, 1993, Michael Carbajal fought Humberto Gonzalez for the WBC and IBF Light Flyweight Titles in Las Vegas. After being knocked down twice earlier in the fight, Carbajal made an incredible comeback, knocking out Gonzalez in the 7th round.

programme.title: Micky Ward vs Alfonso Sanchez
programme.desc: On April 12th, 1997 Micky Ward and Alfonso Sanchez faced eachother at the Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas the 10 round bout ended after seven giving Ward the victory by technical knockout.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Antonio Margarito 2
programme.desc: On December 3rd, 2011, Miguel Cotto fought Antonio Margarito in a highly anticipated championship rematch at the Madison Square Garden in New York. This time around, Cotto showed his dominance from the start and stopped Margarito in the 9th round.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs DeMarcus Corley
programme.desc: On February 26th, 2005 Miguel Cotto fought DeMarcus Corley for the WBO World Super Lightweight title at the Coliseo Ruben Rodriguez in Bayamon with Corley going down twice in the 5th round securing the technical knockout victory for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Delvin Rodriguez
programme.desc: On October 5th, 2013 Miguel Cotto battled Delvin Rodriguez at the Amway Center in Orlando, Fl. The originally twelve round bout lasted three rounds and ended by technical knockout in third round securing the victory for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Joshua Clottey
programme.desc: On June 13th, 2009, Miguel Cotto fought Joshua Clottey for the WBO World Welterweight Title at Madison Square Garden in New York. Despite Clottey landing more shots, Cotto was persistent with his attack, helping him earn a close split decision win.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Kelson Pinto
programme.desc: On September 11th, 2004 Miguel Cotto faced Kelson Pinto at the Coliseo Jose Miguel Agrelot in Hato Rey in battle for WBO World Super lightweight titles with the bout ending halfway through in the sixth round securing the win for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Muhammad Abdullaev
programme.desc: On June 11th, 2005 Miguel Cotto faced Muhammad Abdullaev for the WBO World Super Lightweight title at Madison Square Garden in New York the twelve round bout ended in the ninth securing the victory for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Ricardo Mayorga
programme.desc: On March 12th, 2011, Miguel Cotto fought Ricardo Mayorga for the World Super Welterweight Championship at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. In a great fight, Miguel Cotto prevailed, knocking down Mayorga in the final round and getting the stoppage.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Sergio Martinez
programme.desc: On June 7th, 2014 Miguel Cotto and Sergio Martinez fought eachother for the WBC world middleweight titles in a bout that ended early in the tenth round with a victory for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Shane Mosley
programme.desc: On November 10th. 2007 Miguel Cotto fought Shane Mosley at Madison Square Garden in New York City for the WBA World welterweight title in a full 12 round bout that ended in a unanimous decision victory for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Yuri Foreman
programme.desc: On June 5th, 2010, Miguel Cotto defeated Yuri Foreman at Yankee Stadium, claiming the WBA Super Welterweight title. Foreman's knee injury hindered his performance and Cotto won by TKO in the 9th round.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Zab Judah
programme.desc: On June 9th, 2007, Miguel Cotto fought Zab Judah in a welterweight championship bout at Madison Square Garden in New York. Cotto emerged victorious with a TKO in the 11th round, solidifying his reputation as a formidable welterweight champion.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: Bret Maverick follows a saloon singer named Jenny Hill during her tour to find her outlaw husband. Although believed to be dead, Jenny is convinced he is alive and goes from town to town trying to find him. Complications arise as Bret falls for her.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Infamous outlaw Charlie Gordo is in the North Fork Jail waiting for the U.S. Marshal to take him to Yuma for hanging. Micah learns that the lawman is dead, and Gordo's gang is arriving soon. Micah, Lucas, and others defend the jail from the gang.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Jake Striker buys Brice Hornsby's farm after moving to North Fork. Townspeople befriend Jake's pretty daughter, Abbey, who is deaf and cannot speak. Problems arise when a trail bum attacks her and blames the hired hand. Lucas must find the truth.

programme.title: F Troop
programme.desc: The F Troop receives shocking information regarding their military status. They discover they are not legally enlisted in the army. The troops abandon Fort Courage leaving Captain Parmenter as the only soldier to defend an imminent Indian attack.

programme.title: F Troop
programme.desc: The U.S. Army's Secretary of War arrives at Fort Courage with an important citation which awards the F Troop for having the best morale in the army. However, the fact that the troop is currently in the middle of a big feud complicates matters.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: Wells Fargo detective James Hume hires private investigator Harry Morse to join the hunt for Black Bart. Known as the Poet Highwayman, Bart leaves tantalizing poems at the scenes of his crimes, which may be the key to unmasking Bart's true identity.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: When Elijah Briant is elected sheriff, the mild-mannered druggist and former teacher tries to enforce the law without carrying a weapon. But he soon faces his greatest challenge when the last surviving members of the Wild Bunch descend on his town.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: When a masked bandit terrorizes the stagecoach line, killing a passenger, Theodore Roosevelt and his Elkhorn men join the citizens of Medora to track down the culprit. Can they lay a trap to catch the killer before he strikes again?

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: Bart Maverick noses around the town of Bent Spur and finds himself in the middle of his friend's murder case. He investigates and discovers a town full of suspects, misleading information, and a scorned wife to solve the crime.

programme.title: Cheyenne
programme.desc: While out on an Army mission, Cheyenne shoots a miner in self-defense. He stays to help the miner and his wife, but dangers loom when the Sioux arrive. Their sights are on the miner's wife and his gold.

programme.title: Cheyenne

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: Bart Maverick and his friend Dandy Jim Buckley arrive at a mining camp where a prospector is murdered. The newcomers are suspected of the crime since the prospector had won money off them. Bart must find the real killer.

programme.desc: Bret and Bart Maverick travel to Louisiana and learn their father, Pappy, plans to marry an 18-year-old girl named Josephine St. Cloud. The brothers learn Pappy's marriage is just a ruse to get a gold mine at a low price.

programme.desc: When the F Troop's cook is transferred out of Fort Courage, O'Rourke and Agarn take advantage of the situation to make a quick buck. They proceed to order excess food supplies and sell the rations to the Indians for profit.

programme.desc: Lucia avisa a la familia de Diomedes que no murió, todos se ponen felices. Se hace oficial la muerte de Juancho Roiz. Como Yurleidi, el abogado y su hija no tienen donde quedarse, Lucia les deja pasar la noche en su casa.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Diomedes llega donde sus papás, Elvira y Rafael le piden a Diomedes que los visite más a menudo. En la guajira se realiza un gran entierro y homenaje a Juancho. Diomedes se presenta en el lugar y se despide de Juancho.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: María Paula recibe la visita de Diomedes y el promete nunca abandonarla y estar pendiente del bebe que viene en camino. Diomedes comienza a faltar a sus presentaciones al no superar la muerte de Juancho.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Lucia le reclama a Diomedes porque está recibiendo llamadas de consuelo en Bogotá. Diomedes le dice que es la que dirige su club de fans, pero que no tiene nada con ella. Diomedes sigue reacio a volver a cantar por la muerte de Juancho.

programme.title: Diomedes
programme.desc: Rosa tiene una discusión con Icho porque ella le reclama por una supuesta amante de él, quien termina siendo su hermana. Icho dolido decide romper con el compromiso de su matrimonio.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Ronald da la orden de matar a Emiliano para que no abra la boca. Emiliano le confiesa a Felipe toda la verdad. Por otro lado, Rosario saca las cosas de Emiliano de la pensión. La manada intenta consolar a Rosario con una serenata.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El sicario contratado por Rubén tratará de asesinar a Emiliano. Con lo que no cuenta el criminal, es que el mariachi se sabe defender muy bien. Los cabecillas de la organización deberán buscar una nueva estrategia para mantener en silencio a Emiliano

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Para evitar que Emiliano se declare inocente y la policía descubra quienes son los verdaderos culpables del lavado de dólares, los socios de Corona deciden contratar a los mariachis y en medio de la serenata, se toman fotos junto a Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano es visitado por Corona y éste le muestra las fotos en que Rosario aparece junto a los cabecillas de la organización. Emiliano no tendrá otra opción que acceder a las pretensiones del abogado. Por otro lado, Rosario recibe la visa mexicana.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El comandante Salas revisa el interrogatorio y empieza a dudar de la culpabilidad de Emiliano. Por otro lado, Rosario no puede entrar al reclusorio por ser Emiliano un preso de alta seguridad. Rosario buscara la ayuda de la teniente Morales.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El encuentro en la cárcel entre Emiliano y Rosario resulta muy corto, y sirve para confirmar que la pareja se ama igual que antes. No obstante, el mariachi le advierte a su novia que lo mejor para ella es que no se vuelvan a ver.

programme.title: Leandro

programme.title: Leandro

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: A forensic photographer retreats from the world after witnessing the aftermath of a bizarre murder. programme.title: Holy Hustle

programme.title: Getting Ed Laid

programme.title: Impossible Crimes
programme.desc: An experienced detective investigates a series of implausible murders. Things get a turn when a young nun, Caterina, confesses that she believes herself to be the killer.

programme.title: From Other Worlds

programme.title: Hidden Moon
programme.desc: The son (Wes Bentley) of a wealthy man whose funeral is disrupted by the presence of a mysterious Latin American woman (Ana Serradilla), sets out to salvage his family's reputation by figuring out the exact nature of the woman's relationship with his deceased father. Starring Wes Bentley, Ana Serradilla, Johnathon Schaech

programme.title: Generation Wolf
programme.desc: Generation Wolf talks about a young entrepreneur who is about to lose his business and choose to grow marijuana as an easy way to save it.
